key_insight: MUON achieves the optimal local convergence rate (√χ−1)/(√χ+1), matching momentum and Adam and improving on standard gradient descent’s rate (χ−1)/(χ+1), where χ is the local Hessian condition number.
engineering_relevance: The result gives theoretical support for MUON’s accelerated convergence near a local minimizer, rather than guaranteeing faster end-to-end neural network training.
method: Define a precise measure of optimizer convergence speed.
Establish optimal rates for gradient descent, momentum, RMSprop, Adam, and MUON.
Relate local convergence rates to Hessian conditioning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence and optimality results, but no datasets, empirical benchmarks, or runtime measurements.
watch_item: The highlighted rates are local; the abstract does not specify the tuning requirements or assumptions needed to attain them in practical training.
paper_title: Optimal higher order convergence rates for the MUON optimizer
